hypothesis: On identical real H3 last32 windows and seeds, multiplying cached H3 features by the pre-registered text-RMS/feature-RMS ratio 0.009606920816877307 prevents the step-2 loss, prediction-variance and gradient explosion seen at scale 1 while preserving non-zero gradients, a non-zero optimizer update and exact fresh-process restore.
single_variable: feature_input_scale: raw arm 1.0 versus RMS-match arm 0.009606920816877307; every other resolved argument, sample, seed and source byte is fixed.
parent_baseline: The raw scale=1 arm rerun under the same clean feature-timestep-token implementation; the earlier depth2 run produced loss 10944 -> 7143424 and prediction_std 159.175 -> 3953.595, motivating but not substituting for the paired rerun.

references.title: Fast-WAM: Can Video Generation Models Act as World-Action Models?
fastwam_deploy standalone INT8-H3 StarWAM action trainer
references.revision: dab8058 plus isolated R1 trainer, wrapper, tests and dossier diff

architecture.field: ActionDiT source, clean feature-timestep token and H3 feature adapter
architecture.paper: An action diffusion transformer consumes world-model observation features.
architecture.upstream_code: Pinned ActionDiT/WanBlock source; FeatureConditionedActionModel implements an optional feature-timestep token, although the released LIBERO feature YAML sets feature_condition_include_timestep=false.
architecture.local: Byte-pinned ActionDiT plus a fixed clean-observation t=0 token and a scalar before the H3 feature projector; both arms use the same token and differ only in scalar value.
architecture.rationale: The clean token explicitly separates StarWAM conditioning time t=0 from the cached H3 denoising-curve capture at t=1; it is held fixed in the scale ablation and recorded as a deviation from the released LIBERO YAML.

data.field: paired windows and pre-registered feature scale
data.paper: Dense robot demonstration windows with observation features.
data.upstream_code: 32 action steps and observation tokens pooled to 32 positions.
data.local: Both arms use the same four unique windows from the 277713-window manifest; scale is fixed from 512 feature samples and all 40 task text contexts before execution.
data.rationale: Window/action length and token pooling match while backbone-specific latent magnitude is the controlled variable.

action.upstream_code: Seven-dimensional 32-step actions and eight-dimensional proprio, min/max mapped to [-1,1], clipped to [-5,5].
action.local: Identical dimensions and pinned StarWAM normalization in both arms, including action pad masking.
action.rationale: No action contract variable changes between arms.

objective.paper: Continuous flow matching for action generation.
objective.upstream_code: Shift-5 scheduler and timestep-weighted masked flow-matching MSE.
objective.local: Direct imports from the fixed StarWAM commit, identical seeds and objectives in both arms.
objective.rationale: The scale ablation does not alter flow parameterization.

optimization.paper: Full policy learning requires many epochs.
optimization.upstream_code: AdamW LR1e-4, WD0.01, betas(0.9,0.95), clip1 and BF16.
optimization.local: Same optimizer, two 2-GPU arms, depth2, two optimizer steps, batch1/GPU and identical seed42; this diagnoses stability only.
optimization.rationale: The bounded paired budget is deliberately too small for an effectiveness claim.

evaluation.paper: Closed-loop LIBERO success is the final policy metric.
evaluation.upstream_code: LIBERO rollout is the policy-quality endpoint.
evaluation.local: Scaled arm passes only if restore max_abs=0, all three gradient paths and head update are finite/non-zero, step2/step1 loss<=2, prediction_std<=2, expert-gradient<=10 and projector-gradient<=10; raw is measured with the same predicate.
evaluation.rationale: This is a pre-training stability gate, not action quality or generalization evidence.

decision.rationale: Completed diagnostic: RMS matching greatly reduced absolute scale but failed every pre-registered step-ratio stability threshold when the non-recipe timestep token was enabled and the official warmup schedule was absent. Do not promote this configuration.

result.diagnosis: Feature magnitude was causal but insufficient. The released LIBERO recipe disables the timestep token and uses warmup1000; both were corrected in v2.
